correctness.rationale: All quantifiers specify every finite field in characteristic at least five, with ordered pairs. The rational involution gives an exact partition of every target. The diagonal character sum is \(2q-5\), the off-diagonal is \(q-7-2\chi(-1)-2\chi(-3)-a_q\), and the zero-first-coordinate slice adds \(2(q-1)\). The full energy and five multiplicities follow algebraically from both first and second moments. Distinct roots of the elliptic cubic ensure nonsingularity; the first fourfold field is certified by Hasse plus exact cases. A direct standard-library implementation independently counts each target over 11 prime and 4 prime-square fields and agrees. These finite checks do not replace the all-field proof.
